question: who was the founder of the News paper Bengal Gazette (1780 - India's first News paper?
solution:
The correct answer is __**J.K. Hicky**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **J.K. Hicky** was the founder of the newspaper **Bengal Gazette**, which was India's first newspaper.
 
• The Bengal Gazette was started in the year **1780**.
 
• This newspaper is also known as **Hicky's Bengal Gazette** or the **Calcutta General Advertiser**.
 
• It was a weekly newspaper and played a significant role in the early days of Indian journalism.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **J.K. Hicky** was an Irishman who came to India and started the Bengal Gazette.
 
• The newspaper was known for its critical articles on the British administration in India.
 
• Despite its short run, the Bengal Gazette set a precedent for the freedom of the press in India.
 
• Hicky faced several challenges and legal battles against the British authorities, leading to the eventual shutdown of the paper.
